title: Windsurf Vim and Neovim Extensions Updated
description: The Exafunction organization updated windsurf.vim (March 30) and windsurf.nvim (March 30) extensions. Windsurf is described as a free, ultrafast Copilot alternative for Vim and Neovim editors.

title: VS Code v1.2.22 / v1.3.38 and JetBrains v1.0.68 Releases
description: Continue released multiple updates on March 27, 2026, including VS Code versions 1.2.22 and 1.3.38, and JetBrains version 1.0.68. Key updates include config.yaml fixes, session history filtering by workspace directory, and support for .continue/configs. Previous releases on March 26 included Ollama tool support improvements and bug fixes for file reading operations.
